info.name: COMP60047 Leave Booking System API
info.description: Assessment-grade, ordered API suite for COMP60047 Assignment 1 evidence and Assignment 2 VIVA demonstration. Uses real Firebase JWTs and the final REST contracts. Run folders in numeric order or run the entire collection. The Rate Limiting folder must remain last.

item.name: 00 Authentication and Run Setup
item.description: Initialises unique test emails, obtains the real Firebase ADMIN JWT, and proves claim-to-authority conversion.

exec: pm.test("Credentials are not echoed", () => { const raw = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include(pm.environment.get('adminPassword')); });
pm.test("Firebase ADMIN claim became Spring authority", () => pm.expect(role.authorities).to.include('ROLE_ADMIN'));

item.name: 01 Staff Management Setup
item.description: Creates the Staff bounded-context fixtures needed for genuine Firebase role and ownership testing, then covers Staff REST operations.

exec: pm.test("Job role and start date updated together", () => { pm.expect(staff.jobRole).to.eql('Senior Software Engineer'); pm.expect(staff.roleStartDate).to.eql('2026-04-01'); });

item.name: 02 Firebase Role Identities
item.description: Creates and logs in real Firebase STAFF, MANAGER and HR identities through the application API. Tokens are captured only into secret environment variables.

item.name: 03 Leave Allowances and Carry Over
item.description: Creates current/source allowances, proves Staff/assigned-Manager/Admin access, amendments, usage, duplicate handling and exact capped carry-over.

item.name: 03.05B Manager Cannot Read Unrelated Staff Allowance
03.10 Valid Carry Over Is Capped At Five Days

exec: pm.test("Repeated command does not double carry-over", () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.json().carriedOverDays)).to.eql(5));
pm.test("Usage totals are internally consistent", () => pm.expect(Number(usage.totalUsedDays)).to.eql(Number(usage.totalEntitlement) - Number(usage.totalRemainingDays)));

item.name: 04 Public Holidays and Working Days
item.description: Creates a test-only holiday used by the annual-leave workflow and verifies authenticated retrieval and duplicate protection.

item.name: 05 Annual Leave Lifecycle
item.description: Shows pending and approved cancellation, manager/Admin approval, staff/team/company outstanding filters, working-day charging, exact balance changes, errors and holiday cleanup.

exec: pm.test("No allowance was deducted or restored", () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.json().remainingDays)).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('annualBalanceBefore'))));
pm.test("Request visible to assigned manager", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(r => r.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('annualLeaveRequestId')));
pm.test("Owner receives private reason", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().reason).to.eql('Annual leave VIVA evidence'));
pm.test("Owner list contains annual request", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(r => r.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('annualLeaveRequestId')));

item.name: 05.05A ADMIN Filters Outstanding Requests By Staff

exec: pm.test("Selected staff pending request returned", () => pm.expect(requests.map(r => r.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('annualLeaveRequestId')));
pm.test("Filter contains only selected staff and PENDING status", () => pm.expect(requests.every(r => r.staffMemberId === pm.environment.get('staffId') && r.status === 'PENDING')).to.be.true);

item.name: 05.05B ADMIN Filters Outstanding Requests By Manager Team

exec: pm.test("Selected manager team request returned", () => pm.expect(requests.map(r => r.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('annualLeaveRequestId')));

pm.test("Team filter contains only the selected manager and PENDING status", () => pm.expect(requests.every(r => r.managerId === pm.environment.get('managerId') && r.status === 'PENDING')).to.be.true);
pm.test("Decision comment retained", () => pm.expect(leave.decisionComment).to.eql('Coverage confirmed for VIVA'));
pm.test("Exactly one working day deducted", () => pm.expect(after).to.eql(before - 1));

item.name: 05.13B ADMIN Approves On Behalf Of Manager

exec: pm.test("ADMIN decision metadata retained", () => pm.expect(leave.decisionComment).to.eql('Administrator approval on behalf of manager'));
pm.test("Rejection comment retained", () => pm.expect(leave.decisionComment).to.eql('Coverage cannot be arranged'));

item.name: 06 Half-Day and Overlap Rules
item.description: Proves exact 0.5-day charging, complementary sessions and conflicting duplicate-session rejection.

item.name: 07 Sick Leave and Privacy
item.description: Records sickness immediately without annual allowance use and proves owner-only private detail access.

item.name: 07.03 Manager Cannot Read Private Sickness Request

exec: pm.test("Recorded sickness is cancelled by its owner", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('CANCELLED'));

item.name: 07.06 Sickness Cancellation Still Does Not Affect Allowance

exec: pm.test("Allowance remains unchanged after sickness cancellation", () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.json().remainingDays)).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('sickBalanceBefore'))));

item.name: 08 HR Approval Workflow
item.description: Demonstrates explicit manager referral, HR-only decisions, outstanding queries, approval and rejection on separate requests.

exec: pm.test("Referral appears in HR queue", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(r => r.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('hrApprovalLeaveRequestId')));
pm.test("HR decision comment retained", () => pm.expect(leave.decisionComment).to.eql('HR policy confirmed'));

item.name: 09 Team, Staff and Calendar Access
item.description: Covers manager-team Staff access, outstanding date filtering, team calendar visibility and unrelated-manager denial.

exec: pm.test("Primary staff appears in manager team", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(s => s.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('staffId')));

item.name: 09.05 Manager Team Calendar Is Privacy Safe

exec: const calendar = pm.response.json(); const raw = JSON.stringify(calendar);
pm.test("Calendar contains no reason field", () => pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('reason'));
pm.test("Approved team leave remains visible", () => pm.expect(calendar.map(e => e.leaveRequestId)).to.include(pm.environment.get('morningLeaveRequestId')));

item.name: 09.06 Unrelated Manager Cannot Read Team Calendar
10 Notifications
item.description: Queries broker-backed inbox projections after the preceding workflows and verifies owner/Admin access.

exec: pm.test("Manager received pending alert", () => pm.expect(notifications.some(n => n.type === 'MANAGER_PENDING_LEAVE')).to.be.true);

item.name: 11 Reporting
item.description: Verifies the ADMIN-only, privacy-safe asynchronous reporting projection.

exec: const reports = pm.response.json(); const raw = JSON.stringify(reports);
pm.test("Reporting excludes reasons and identity names", () => { pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('reason'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('firstName'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('email'); });

item.name: 12 Leave Audit
item.description: Verifies the ADMIN-only business audit projection, lifecycle actions, source event identity and privacy exclusions.

exec: const audit = pm.response.json(); const raw = JSON.stringify(audit); const actions = audit.map(a => a.action);
pm.test("Audit has source event identities", () => pm.expect(audit.every(a => Number.isInteger(a.sourceEventId))).to.be.true);

pm.test("Audit excludes reasons and credentials", () => { pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('Private medical information'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('password'); pm.expect(raw).not.to.include('Token'); });

item.name: 13 HR Sync
item.description: Verifies the ADMIN-readable outbound HR absence projection and strict privacy-safe payload.

exec: const rows = pm.response.json(); const raw = JSON.stringify(rows); const actions = rows.map(r => r.syncAction);

pm.test("No names, emails, reasons or credentials leak", () => { for (const forbidden of ['firstName','surname','email','reason','password','idToken','Private medical information']) pm.expect(raw).not.to.include(forbidden); });

item.name: 13.02 HR Role Cannot Read ADMIN Integration Projection
14 Security and Error Contract
item.description: Makes 401, malformed JWT, 403, ownership and response-header hardening visible for the VIVA.

item.name: 15 Rate Limiting - Run Last
item.description: Loops one authenticated endpoint until the actual API limit returns 429. This folder is intentionally last so its cooldown cannot disrupt other evidence.

exec: if (iteration >= 70) { pm.test('429 reached within bounded attempts', () => pm.expect.fail('No 429 after 70 attempts')); pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); }
